name: Crowley Isla Grande Terminal - San Juan PR
type: Marine terminal / container port (LNG-fueled microgrid, ConRo)

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (18.45679,-66.093211) landed on the Isla Grande airport runway ~1km NE of the terminal. True terminal located SW of the runway via satellite + Street View; access road is Calle Lindbergh running along the airport's south edge.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Multi-lane gate complex with a long overhead steel canopy spanning the inbound/outbound lanes, visible in Street View (sv12/sv14) at ~18.4546,-66.1015. Controlled marine-terminal gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Gate booth structures sit beneath the canopy at the gate lanes; an additional red/pink kiosk-style booth is present. Staffed marine-terminal gate per port operating practice.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple parallel lanes under the canopy; inbound and outbound separated within the gate complex.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Marine terminal — primary cargo handling is vessel-side at the ConRo pier, not building dock doors. Counted ~12 warehouse/maintenance-building dock positions; low-confidence band 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large chassis/trailer/container marshalling yard with hundreds of trailers and container stacks visible in tight imagery.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits directly on Calle Lindbergh; trailer staging already lines the road, so a queue can spill onto the public road.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur entering the terminal property.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: ConRo pier, multiple warehouse and maintenance buildings, large open container/chassis yard.

citations.claim: Crowley locator lists San Juan / Front Isla Grande Airport, San Juan PR 00907 as an active Caribbean port terminal.
Crowley's LNG ConRo ship El Coqui delivered first cargo to the modernized Isla Grande Terminal in San Juan; Crowley has served PR from the 85-acre Isla Grande terminal since 1954.

verification.rationale: Flagship Crowley PR gateway, actively operating with new gantry cranes/pier and LNG ConRo service; no exit signals.
